name: opencode-blackhole
description: Deterministic compaction + observational memory for OpenCode. Replaces the native LLM summarizer with a zero-cost structural summary, and keeps durable session memory across compactions.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/server.js --target node --format esm --external @opencode/plugin --external jsonc-parser
scripts.dev: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/server.js --target node --format esm --external @opencode/plugin --external jsonc-parser --watch
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test ./tests && bun run build
